front: A golden amulet that becomes your deity's symbol, boosts Religion, and sheds light that can reveal spirits.
back:
Becomes your deity's symbol when invested. +1 item bonus to Religion. Casts dim light in a 20-ft emanation.
Activate - Spiritual Light (2 actions; concentrate, light, revelation; once per day): the light becomes bright for 10 minutes and shines through bodies to reveal hints of spirits. Creatures in the light take -1 status penalty to Deception and Stealth. You can Dismiss.
